mechanism: Every paper now gets a row in open_practices, so a paper with no flagged sentence reads FALSE instead of missing. No answer changed.
Only a capital R counts as a word for code, so a statistic such as r(68) = .58 no longer makes a sentence a code statement.
The statements of these papers offer data only on request, and they no longer count as open data.
Operating system files such as .DS_Store and __MACOSX folders are left out, and the file types of cause FILE_TYPE_TABLE apply.
The DOI of a deposit is read only for a repository that holds data, so it changes with data_archive.
The languages are read from the code files found.
